name: Chengdu Galaxy Magnets Co.,Ltd.
summary: Chengdu Galaxy Magnets Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of a new generation of bonded NdFeB rare-earth magnet components and parts worldwide. The company offers bonded NdFeB magnets used in spindle, stepping, synchronous, DC, and brushless DC motors, as well as sensors.
